title: Stars and constellations
examples: Teacher, how do we know which stars belong together?
Can you show me a picture of the Plough in the sky?
Do all stars shine the same way?

explain.say: Look up at the night sky sometimes.

items: We can see them every night.

explain.say: One famous pattern is called the Plough.
The Plough is actually part of a bigger group.
Stars do not make their own light.
The Sun is a star that shines for us.
In real life, the stars help us tell time.

faq.a: A constellation is a pattern of stars that look like something.

faq.q: Does the Plough move across the sky?
faq.a: Yes, the patterns of stars appear to move over the course of the night.
asks: Does the sky change at night?

faq.a: Stars shine because they are giant balls of hot gas that make their own light.
Yes, our Sun is a star, and it is very close to Earth.
asks: Is the Sun like a star?

faq.a: The visible patterns can look different depending on where you are on Earth.
asks: Do all people see the same stars?

facts: Constellations are patterns made by groups of stars.
The Plough is a recognizable pattern in the night sky.
Stars shine because they produce their own light.
The Sun is a star that orbits the center of our solar system.

quiz.say: Which of these is a pattern of stars?
quiz.why: The Plough is a well-known pattern of stars that people see in the sky.

wrong.0: The Milky Way is a whole galaxy, not a specific star pattern.
wrong.1: The Sun is a star, but it is one object, not a pattern of many stars.
wrong.3: The Moon reflects light from the Sun; it does not make its own star pattern.

quiz.say: What is the best way to describe how stars shine?

options.show: They bounce light from other stars
options.say: They bounce light from other stars

options.show: They are lit up by the Sun
options.say: They are lit up by the Sun

quiz.why: Stars are giant balls of hot gas that create their own light through burning.

wrong.1: This is like how the Moon works, but stars are much stronger.
wrong.2: Only the Sun shines so brightly; other stars shine by themselves.
wrong.3: Planets reflect light; stars generate their own light source.

quiz.say: If you see a pattern of stars, what is it called?
quiz.why: A constellation is the name given to a recognizable pattern of stars.

wrong.0: A planet orbits a star; it is not a pattern of stars.
wrong.1: This is too general; the correct specific term is constellation.
wrong.3: A galaxy is a huge collection of billions of stars, not just a pattern.
